// A fixture, not code: a route that reads a saved key and hands it back. The structure check must refuse this file.
import { readSecret } from "@/server/secrets/read-secret";
import { withRoute } from "@/server/logging";

export const GET = withRoute("/api/leaky", async () => {
  const key = await readSecret({} as never, "u", "youtube_data_api_key");
  return Response.json({ key });
});
